summary: Implemented grpc.health.v1.Health Check and Watch for the native Rust gRPC server. The aggregate service and sglang.runtime.v1.SglangService report SERVING when the existing RuntimeHandle health predicate is true, and NOT_SERVING when it is false or raises. The existing SglangService.HealthCheck RPC remains available. This completes only the standard-health portion of the umbrella feature request; multimodal transport and RL lifecycle semantics remain unimplemented.

tests.what_was_measured: Compiled the Rust gRPC crate with the pinned Rust 1.92 toolchain and ran 14 unit tests, including the native-to-standard serving-status mapping.
Checked all sglang-grpc Rust targets with warnings denied.
Produced a new optimized native extension at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e09f84444f95/native-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so from the changed source and locked dependency graph.

Live grpcio client interoperability against the rebuilt native server: aggregate and named Check return SERVING, unknown Check and Watch return NOT_FOUND, and Watch publishes a SERVING-to-NOT_SERVING transition. Result: 4 passed and 2 subtests passed.
Existing Python bridge compatibility tests. Result: 2 passed.

gpu_evidence: The implemented standard gRPC health control plane contains no GPU computation or numerical output. A GPU run would not validate this protocol behavior, so no GPU was allocated or modified.
remaining_limitations: The broader issue's native gRPC multimodal image, audio, and video request support was not implemented or model-qualified.
Aggregated and encoder-disaggregated multimodal coverage was not added; no multimodal model weights were available or used.
RL-specific operations and a formal pause/drain, weight-update, and resume lifecycle API were not implemented.

No full model server was launched. The live test exercises the rebuilt native transport and dynamic engine-health state with a deterministic mock RuntimeHandle, not model inference or distributed execution.
tonic-health 0.12 returns NOT_FOUND for Watch on an unregistered service, matching its Check behavior; registered aggregate and native service names support streaming Watch transitions.

The prepared image did not initially contain Cargo. The repository-pinned Rust 1.92.0 toolchain was installed for this job; build targets and the rebuilt library were kept under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e09f84444f95.
